message:
🚀 Flex GUI Pro — Version 6.5.0 Official Release Notes
This public release introduces powerful local layout rigging tools, custom UI shape templates, and granular typography transition controls directly into the expansion ecosystem.

⭐ New Features & Layout Rigging
1. Shapes Tab UI Template Expansion
41+ UI Layout Templates: Added over 41 production-ready user interface templates built entirely out of native After Effects shape layers to assemble look-books and app animations in seconds.

Custom Layout Builder: Introduced an interactive layout tool to generate custom positioning structures and parametric grids. Combined with the Proximity Effector System, this gives you massive control over dynamic spatial scaling and spatial wiggles.

2. Advanced Text & Preview Engine Upgrades
In/Out Expression Toggles: The Text tab now features full In/Out structural toggles for expression-based animations, allowing you to selectively isolate introduction or exit transitions.

Keyframe Mode Conversion: Ported a collection of core text animations to support Keyframe Mode, bypassing expression execution to let you map custom graph curves directly on the timeline.

Live Preview Hover Toggle: Added a dedicated Toggle Hover Button right in the tab interface to instantly enable or disable the hovering floating text animation preview element.

All core ExtendScript library dependencies, HTML signatures, and internal line verification hashes have been systematically updated and validated for stable deployment.
